resources.string: Complete goals. Feed Pip. Don\'t doomscroll.

e.g. Gym, Study 1 hr, Ship a video…

Add a goal first — then complete it to feed %1$s.

• Pick your Pip (cat, dog, bunny, hamster) — unlock wolves, foxes, dragons and more with care streaks and achievements.
• Add real-life goals (gym, study, ship a video). Checking one off feeds Pip.
• Stats decay in real time: hunger, happiness, energy — plus ATTENTION, which drains when Pip is ignored. Pet often!
• Tap Pip to pet, double-tap to play. Screen off = Pip sleeps (decay ×0.1); screen on = wake recap.
• Set the live wallpaper as your LOCK-SCREEN wallpaper (Samsung: separate lock-screen wallpaper) so Pip greets you on every wake.
• Log doomscrolling (or enable auto-detect) and Pip sulks for 30 minutes.
• 👑 Premium unlocks Wild + Mystical pets instantly via license key.
All sound effects are synthesized in code at first launch — this app ships zero audio files.
PixelPet works fully offline. The optional doomscroll auto-detector uses Android\'s UsageStats API on-device only; nothing ever leaves your phone.
